function.name: get_formula_from_smiles
function.description: Generate a chemical formula from a SMILES string using RDKit.

function.name: retrieve_protons_shifts
function.description: Retrieve the proton chemical shifts ranges for hydrocarbons.

function.name: retrieve_aromatic_protons_shifts
function.description: Retrieve the proton shifts ranges for aromatic hydrocarbons.

function.name: retrieve_carbon_shifts
function.description: Retrieve the carbon chemical shifts ranges for various functional groups in organic compounds.

function.name: search_by_smiles
function.description: Search the NMRShift database for entries matching or chemically similar to the given SMILES.

smiles.description: The SMILES representation of the compound to search for in the NMRShift database

top_k.description: The maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10

function.name: carbon_nmr_spectra
function.description: Return the 13C NMR spectra for the sample at hand.

function.name: proton_nmr_spectra
function.description: Returns the 1H NMR spectra for a given SMILES string.

function.name: ir_spectra
function.description: Returns the IR spectra for the sample at hand. This spectra may not be accurate for all compounds. It works best for identifying functional groups such as C=O.

function.name: hsqc_nmr_spectra
function.description: Returns the HSQC (Heteronuclear Single Quantum Coherence) NMR spectra for the sample at hand.

function.name: mass_spectrometry_spectra
function.description: Returns the mass spectrometry spectra for the sample at hand using the Electrospray Ionization (ESI) technique.

function.name: retrieve_isotope_distribution
function.description: Retrieve the isotopic distribution of common elements in organic chemistry.

function.name: retrieve_dbe_formula
function.description: Retrieve the formula for calculating the Double Bond Equivalent (DBE).

function.name: obtain_isomers_from_molecular_formula
function.description: Obtain isomers for a given molecular formula.

molecular_formula.description: The molecular formula of the compound for which to retrieve isomers.

limit.description: The maximum number of isomers to retrieve. 0 means no limit.

function.name: validate_smiles
function.description: Validate a SMILES string to check if it represents a valid chemical structure.

function.name: simulate_spectra
function.description: The simulated spectra of the compound

smiles.description: The SMILES representation of the compound to simulate spectra for
